title: D-091 TW1 follow-up: the review-slot lock waits through Windows sharing violations instead of refusing at once (windows-latest race-test flake)
objective: On Windows, os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) on the review-slot lock file can raise PermissionError while another process still has a just-deleted lock file open (delete-pending), and review_slots._SlotLock.acquire treats any non-FileExistsError OSError as an immediate slot_lock_error refusal. Under real contention a racer that should get a free slot is refused: RaceTests::test_global_last_slot_never_double_taken failed 1 != 2 on windows-latest in PR #312 CI (run 37001721581, job 110820703299) after M0-T171 merged (M0-T171 G3/G4 delta note (d) predicted this). Treat PermissionError on Windows as busy and retry to the deadline (never a stale takeover on it), refusing only at the timeout; keep POSIX behavior and every fail-closed outcome; keep holder reads short-lived. Update test_lock_error_fails_closed accordingly and add deterministic tests that inject transient and persistent PermissionError.
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
forbidden_paths: locking.py, run_budget.py, resource_sampling.py (accepted; do not edit)
any change that lets a reservation be granted without the lock or without a durable record
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
acceptance_scenarios: primary: a transient PermissionError on lock creation (simulated, both platforms) makes the reservation wait and then succeed; no refusal
persistent: a lock path that stays unusable (a directory) refuses at the deadline with admitted False and no reservation (slot_lock_timeout on both platforms)
race: the separate-process races still give exactly 2 global winners and exactly 1 per lane, repeated; no over-admission ever
regression: POSIX behavior and every other review-slot test unchanged; a lock error other than a sharing violation still fails closed
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
